items.name: Brisket sandwich
items.description: Sliced-brisket sandwich at the waterfront grill — Texas protein in the park's best-seated building.
items.verdict: The best hot lunch at the park. Eat it indoors at the heat peak and call it strategy.

items.name: Funnel cake
items.description: Fresh funnel cake from the quarry-rim cart, eaten at the overlook.
items.verdict: The view does half the work and the sugar does the rest. The park's correct dessert.

items.name: Turkey leg
items.description: The smoked turkey leg, walked from cart to coaster queue.
items.verdict: A theme-park rite with real utility: protein, portable, shareable. Split it or commit.
